title: The Diversity of India
description: One country, a thousand worlds — 700 languages, every major religion, and a new culture every few hundred kilometres. #india #diversity #culture #incredibleindia

scenes.text: India isn't one country. It's a thousand worlds in one.
Travel a few hundred kilometres and the language changes completely.
So does the food, the clothing, and even the gods people pray to.
Every major religion on Earth lives here, side by side.
28 states, hundreds of festivals, countless traditions.
And somehow, it all becomes one India.
